mapper.select:
WITH selected_area AS ( SELECT area_code, sido_code, sigungu_code, eupmyeondong_code, name, full_name,
level AS selected_level
CASE WHEN match_priority = 0 AND ( CASE level WHEN 'SIDO' THEN 1 WHEN 'SIGUNGU' THEN 2 WHEN 'EUPMYEONDONG' THEN 3 WHEN 'JIPGYEGU' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END ) > ( CASE #{areaLevel} WHEN 'SIDO' THEN 1 WHEN 'SIGUNGU' THEN 2 WHEN 'EUPMYEONDONG' THEN 3 WHEN 'JIPGYEGU' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END ) THEN level ELSE #{areaLevel} END AS selected_level
FROM ( SELECT c.*, CASE WHEN c.area_code = #{areaCode} THEN 0 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 2 AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = #{areaCode} THEN 1 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 3, 8) = '00000000' AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 2) THEN 2 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{areaCode} THEN 3 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 5) THEN 4 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{areaCode} THEN 5 WHEN LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 8) THEN 6 ELSE 9 END AS match_priority FROM public.sd_area_code c WHERE c.area_code = #{areaCode} OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 2 AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = #{areaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 3, 8) = '00000000' AND c.level = 'SIDO' AND c.sido_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 2) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 5 AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = #{areaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 6, 5) = '00000' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sigungu_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 5) ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 8 AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = #{areaCode} ) OR ( LENGTH(#{areaCode}) = 10 AND SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 9, 2) = '00' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.eupmyeondong_code = SUBSTRING(#{areaCode}, 1, 8) ) ORDER BY match_priority, c.area_code LIMIT 1 ) matched_area LIMIT 1 ), scope_candidates AS ( SELECT DISTINCT area_code, population_area_level, priority FROM ( SELECT s.area_code, 'SIDO' AS population_area_level, 1 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 'SIGUNGU' AS population_area_level, 2 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.sigungu_code || '00000' AS area_code, 'SIGUNGU' AS population_area_level, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND c.sigungu_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 'EUPMYEONDONG' AS population_area_level, 4 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIDO' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code
UNION ALL
SELECT s.area_code, 'SIGUNGU' AS population_area_level, 1 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIGUNGU'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.sigungu_code || '00000' AS area_code, 'SIGUNGU' AS population_area_level, 2 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIGUNGU' AND s.sigungu_code IS NOT NULL AND s.sigungu_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 'EUPMYEONDONG' AS population_area_level, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code
UNION ALL
SELECT s.area_code, 'EUPMYEONDONG' AS population_area_level, 1 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG'
UNION ALL
SELECT s.eupmyeondong_code || '00' AS area_code, 'EUPMYEONDONG' AS population_area_level, 2 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND s.eupmyeondong_code IS NOT NULL AND s.eupmyeondong_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT s.area_code, 'TONG_BAN' AS population_area_level, 3 AS priority FROM selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG'
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 'EUPMYEONDONG' AS population_area_level, 1 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code = s.eupmyeondong_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.eupmyeondong_code || '00' AS area_code, 'EUPMYEONDONG' AS population_area_level, 2 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code = s.eupmyeondong_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code IS NOT NULL AND c.eupmyeondong_code != ''
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 'TONG_BAN' AS population_area_level, 3 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code AND c.eupmyeondong_code = s.eupmyeondong_code
UNION ALL
SELECT c.area_code, 'SIGUNGU' AS population_area_level, 4 AS priority FROM public.sd_area_code c CROSS JOIN selected_area s WHERE s.selected_level = 'JIPGYEGU' AND c.level = 'SIGUNGU' AND c.sido_code = s.sido_code AND c.sigungu_code = s.sigungu_code ) candidates WHERE area_code IS NOT NULL AND area_code != '' ), population_matches AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.resident_population_id, sc.priority FROM scope_candidates sc JOIN public.sd_resident_population p ON p.area_code = sc.area_code AND p.area_level = sc.population_area_level WHERE p.reg_se_cd = '1'
AND p.stats_ym = REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(#{baseDate} AS varchar), 1, 7), '-', '')
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT p.resident_population_id, sc.priority FROM scope_candidates sc CROSS JOIN selected_area s JOIN public.sd_area_admin_legal_mapping m ON m.legal_area_code = sc.area_code AND m.source_code = 'KOSIS_LEGAL_ADMIN_LINK' JOIN public.sd_resident_population p ON p.admm_cd = m.admin_area_code AND p.area_level = sc.population_area_level WHERE s.selected_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND sc.population_area_level = 'EUPMYEONDONG' AND p.reg_se_cd = '1'
AND p.stats_ym = REPLACE(SUBSTRING(CAST(#{baseDate} AS varchar), 1, 7), '-', '')
), available_priority AS ( SELECT MIN(pm.priority) AS priority FROM population_matches pm ), latest_stats AS ( SELECT MAX(p.stats_ym) AS stats_ym FROM public.sd_resident_population p JOIN population_matches pm ON pm.resident_population_id = p.resident_population_id JOIN available_priority ap ON ap.priority = pm.priority ), filtered_population AS ( SELECT DISTINCT p.* FROM public.sd_resident_population p JOIN population_matches pm ON pm.resident_population_id = p.resident_population_id JOIN available_priority ap ON ap.priority = pm.priority JOIN latest_stats ls ON ls.stats_ym = p.stats_ym WHERE p.reg_se_cd = '1' ) SELECT MIN(p.resident_population_id) AS population_id, s.area_code, s.name AS area_name, s.full_name, 'MOIS_ADMM_SEXD_AGE_PPLTN' AS source_code, CAST(SUBSTRING(MAX(p.stats_ym), 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTRING(MAX(p.stats_ym), 5, 2) || '-01' AS date) AS base_date, '00' AS hour, SUM(p.total_population) AS total_population, SUM(p.male_population) AS male_population, SUM(p.female_population) AS female_population, SUM(p.male_0_9) AS male0To9, SUM(p.male_10_19) AS male10To19, SUM(p.male_20_29) AS male20To29, SUM(p.male_30_39) AS male30To39, SUM(p.male_40_49) AS male40To49, SUM(p.male_50_59) AS male50To59, SUM(p.male_60_69) AS male60To69, SUM(p.male_70_79) AS male70To79, SUM(p.male_80_89) AS male80To89, SUM(p.male_90_99) AS male90To99, SUM(p.male_100_over) AS male100Over, SUM(p.female_0_9) AS female0To9, SUM(p.female_10_19) AS female10To19, SUM(p.female_20_29) AS female20To29, SUM(p.female_30_39) AS female30To39, SUM(p.female_40_49) AS female40To49, SUM(p.female_50_59) AS female50To59, SUM(p.female_60_69) AS female60To69, SUM(p.female_70_79) AS female70To79, SUM(p.female_80_89) AS female80To89, SUM(p.female_90_99) AS female90To99, SUM(p.female_100_over) AS female100Over, MAX(CAST(p.metadata AS varchar)) AS metadata, MAX(p.created_at) AS created_at, MAX(p.updated_at) AS updated_at FROM filtered_population p CROSS JOIN selected_area s GROUP BY s.area_code, s.name, s.full_name
